title: Default text requests now take the fast lane
summary:
A tuning day: faster default text, leaner auth, personalized model routing, and an early semantic cache for images.

The default text model now points to openai-fast, while authentication token validation was optimized by 83%. Less time spent checking credentials; more time spent getting a response.

A user-specific model mapping system landed, creating the groundwork for accounts to resolve model choices according to their own configuration rather than one universal mapping.

A proof of concept adds caching for vectorized images using text embeddings, exploring a semantic memory layer for repeated or closely related image work.
